Meta.title: Teleagent — agents ↔ Telegram, local-first
Meta.description: Local bridge between AI agents and Telegram. Alerts and human decisions in the loop — no VPS, no public webhook.
Meta.ogDescription: When your agent needs you, Telegram answers — and the agent keeps going.

Footer.tagline: Local bridge between AI agents and Telegram. No VPS. No public webhook. You're in the loop.

Hero.subtitle: When your agent needs you, Telegram answers — and the flow continues. No VPS. No public webhook.

HowItWorks.title: One bot. One process. N projects.
HowItWorks.subtitle: Hover (or tap) the nodes — the signal shows the path from request to your decision.

agent.title: Agent
agent.body: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex… call the CLI or local API.

bridge.title: Local bridge
bridge.body: teleagent serve runs on your machine. Long polling + HTTP on 127.0.0.1.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.body: Alerts and decision buttons land in your chat — allowlist by user id.

you.title: You
you.body: Reply on your phone. The agent gets JSON and continues on its own.

LiveDemo.title: The agent asks. You decide from your pocket.
LiveDemo.subtitle: Simulation of the `ask` flow: blocks the agent, sends buttons on Telegram, returns JSON, and moves on.
LiveDemo.question: Promote the deploy to production?

cli.title: CLI + localhost API
cli.body: alert, ask, cancel, status — and HTTP on 127.0.0.1:3847 for any runtime.

desktop.title: Windows app

allowlist.title: Allowlist
allowlist.body: Only Telegram user ids you authorize can control the bot.

skill.title: Cursor skill
skill.body: Ready-made instructions so the agent uses ask/alert in the loop without guessing intent.

SupportBand.title: If Teleagent saved you from a bad deploy, you can give back.
SupportBand.body: The project is open source (MIT). Support via GitHub Sponsors helps maintain the bridge, desktop app, and docs — no paywall, no telemetry.

CtaBand.title: Put the human in the loop today.
CtaBand.body: Download the Windows hub or run the CLI. In minutes your agent talks to you on Telegram.
